about: A species caught only as one of its forms is drawn as that form on the Dex's SIZE page (Paolo's decision of 2026-10-04: the form seen first is the look while only forms have been seen). From a scratch copy of Paolo's Falkner save, the Dex in its National mode (savedit marks Pikachu, which switches it on) and the player put by Union Cave's Route 33 mouth with a Master Ball, an Alolan Raichu is forced on the next step (gDiagForceBattleSpecies 1094) with the field's RNG pinned, and caught: the first Raichu the Dex has, so it is caught only as the Alolan form. The Dex opens on No. 0025 Pikachu; RIGHT moves to No. 0026, whose top screen draws the Alolan Raichu (gDiagDexShown, round 15). A opens its INFO page and the SIZE tab (the second, touched at 96,176) its SIZE page: the front beside the trainer (ov18_021F4DDC, gDiagDexSizeShown) and the icon on the weight check (ov18_021F4D64, gDiagDexSizeIcon) are the Alolan Raichu, the FORMS page's first entry. Both drew Raichu itself (26) before: a build with them reading curSpecies again fails here with 26.
